headline: Archipelago v1.0.0 brings Ratchet & Clank multiworld play
summary: Archipelago v1.0.0 lets Ratchet & Clank players join an Archipelago multiworld, with defeating Drek as the completion goal (#5). Lock-strafe v1.0.3 disables strafing on the hoverboard so L2 and R2 can perform tricks, then restores it on dismount (#4). Both releases were built against OpenRAC mod SDK 1.10.1.
highlights: The Archipelago world package is built and tested against Archipelago 0.6.8; a release-job fix includes it alongside the mod archives (#5, #6).
A signed mod index, submission forms and bot, pictures and Discussions landed (#7). The index pre-release is a mod catalogue rather than a playable mod.
The repository and its references now use openrac-mods; submission and review jobs act through openrac-bot (#19, #20).
